name: lightroom-mcp-unified
description: Catalog, develop, previews, masks and Enhance via a Lightroom Classic Lua plugin.
long_description: 31 MCP tools in one bridge. Includes runtime capability checks and explicit limitations for interactive masks and AI processing. Install the bundled Lua plugin, restart Lightroom, then use the tools. See the README and feature audit for actual verification scope.

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search for photos in Lightroom catalog by criteria (paginated, default limit 100). Providing at least one filter (filename, keywords, rating, or date) significantly improves performance on large catalogs.

tools.name: get_selected_photos
tools.description: Get currently selected photos in Lightroom (or filmstrip if no selection). Paginated, default limit 100.

tools.name: get_photo_metadata
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific photo: EXIF, title/caption/headline, GPS (latitude/longitude/altitude), IPTC location (sublocation/city/stateProvince/country/isoCountryCode), copyright, and develop settings

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all collections in Lightroom catalog (paginated, default limit 100)

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add photos to a collection

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.description: Add or remove keywords from photos

tools.name: set_rating
tools.description: Set star rating for photos

tools.name: import_photos
tools.description: Import photos into Lightroom catalog

tools.name: export_photos
tools.description: Export photos from Lightroom

tools.name: list_develop_presets
tools.description: List Lightroom-visible Develop presets and plugin-managed preset checkpoints

tools.name: get_develop_preset
tools.description: Read the settings and backing-file metadata for one exact Develop preset. Use preset_uuid or provide folder/scope when names are duplicated.

tools.name: compare_develop_presets
tools.description: Compare two Develop presets and return a deterministic per-setting diff for iterative style matching

tools.name: create_develop_preset
tools.description: Create a versioned plugin-managed Develop preset checkpoint from selected settings on one photo. The checkpoint is hidden from the Develop panel; export it for handoff.

tools.name: export_develop_preset
tools.description: Copy one exact custom or plugin-managed Develop preset backing file to a destination directory. Existing files are never overwritten; built-in presets without backing files cannot be exported.

tools.name: apply_develop_preset
tools.description: Apply one exact Develop preset to one or more photos

tools.name: copy_develop_settings
tools.description: Copy Develop settings from one photo to others

tools.name: set_develop_settings
tools.description: Set Develop settings directly on a photo. Keys use allowlisted Lightroom SDK names (Exposure2012, WhiteBalance, Contrast2012, Highlights2012, Shadows2012, Whites2012, Blacks2012, Clarity2012, Vibrance, Saturation, HueAdjustmentRed, SaturationAdjustmentOrange, LuminanceAdjustmentYellow, etc.), plus RGB composite and per-channel point curves via ToneCurvePV2012, ToneCurvePV2012Red, ToneCurvePV2012Green, and ToneCurvePV2012Blue.

tools.name: lr_ping
tools.description: Check the authenticated Lightroom connection and runtime version.

tools.name: lr_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect actual Lightroom runtime APIs, supported sliders and limits, and feature caveats before using version-dependent tools.

tools.name: lr_get_settings
tools.description: Read the active photo's current develop settings, controller slider ranges, ID, filename and rating.

tools.name: lr_apply_settings
tools.description: Set absolute global develop slider values on the active photo. Preflight all names and ranges, then report values read back from Lightroom. This is not AI Denoise.

tools.name: lr_batch_apply_settings
tools.description: Apply absolute global settings to the explicitly selected photos using catalog SDK keys. An empty selection is an error. Reports per-photo failures; ordinary noise sliders are not AI Denoise.

tools.name: lr_auto_tone
tools.description: Run Lightroom Auto Tone on the active photo.

tools.name: lr_reset
tools.description: Reset ALL develop adjustments on the active photo. Existing edits will be replaced by defaults.

tools.name: lr_export_preview
tools.description: Render the active photo's current edits as an sRGB JPEG and return MCP image content. Rendering is done by Lightroom, including Nikon NEF decoding. Removes temporary render files.

tools.name: lr_crop
tools.description: Crop the active photo in normalized 0..1 coordinates and/or straighten it. Checks the final combined rectangle before writing.

tools.name: lr_add_mask
tools.description: Start a mask using Lightroom's SDK. Some types require drawing, sampling or choosing a person/object in Lightroom. Geometry parameters are not supported. Adjustments are applied only to a verified newly selected mask; a pending operation is never reported as completed.

tools.name: lr_update_mask
tools.description: Set local sliders on the mask currently selected in Lightroom. Fails when the SDK cannot verify a selected mask. Does not create a mask.

tools.name: lr_lens_blur
tools.description: Control Lens Blur when exposed by this Lightroom runtime. GPU/image support is determined by Lightroom. Errors are reported and accepted requests do not certify completion of background AI processing.

tools.name: lr_enhance
tools.description: Request AI Enhance using Lightroom's runtime API when available. This differs from ordinary noise-reduction sliders. Returns submission status, not a claim that a DNG was created or background processing finished.

request_port.title: Plugin request port
request_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin listens on for requests. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.

response_port.title: Plugin response port
response_port.description: TCP port the Lightroom plugin sends responses on. Must match the Plug-in Manager setting.
